## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's code style and formatting standards
- [ ] Ran `bun run check` (0 errors)
- [ ] Ran `bun run lint` (0 errors)
- [ ] Ran `bun run format:check` and `bun run format:md:check`
- [ ] Ran `bun run build` and verified the pages generate cleanly
- [ ] If adding/editing a cheatsheet, verified heading increments (`##` for sections, `###` for cards) and matching code fences
